text: Summarization means condensing or recapping existing content without creating substantially new material. Routine, non-sensitive summarization is low sensitivity and low risk and should use direct_small.

Retrieval means locating or finding authoritative information in documentation, policies, handbooks, or knowledge bases. Internal retrieval is medium sensitivity and medium risk and should use verified_cascade. Words such as privileged, critical, authoritative, or infrastructure do not by themselves make the task high risk.

Technical reasoning means diagnosing, analyzing, debugging, or reasoning about technical systems. Ordinary debugging is medium sensitivity and medium risk and should use verified_cascade. Technical reasoning becomes high risk and direct_frontier when failure could corrupt financial records or create similarly severe consequences.
Compliance means assessing legal, regulatory, contractual, privacy, retention, or data-governance obligations. Compliance workloads are high sensitivity and high risk and should use direct_frontier.

Classification means assigning content to predefined labels, topics, categories, or taxonomies. Routine classification of non-sensitive information is low sensitivity and low risk and should use direct_small.

Generation means creating substantially new content rather than summarizing existing material. Routine non-sensitive generation should use direct_small. Customer-facing content requiring review is medium sensitivity and medium risk and should use verified_cascade. Sensitive executive, financial, legal, or regulatory communications are high sensitivity and high risk and should use direct_frontier.
